description: Prepare creating an ad in Telegram Ads through its API. The ad is created paused. cpm and daily_budget_limit are in the Telegram account's currency. Changes nothing: returns a preview_id (15 min, one use) for execute_prepared_change.

cpm.description: CPM bid in the account currency.

daily_budget_limit.description: Daily limit in the account currency.

reason.description: Why, with numbers (shown to the approver).

title.description: Ad name in the account, up to 128 bytes.

website_name.description: Site name for an external link.

name: prepare_telegram_ad_publish
